queries.cohorts:
SELECT cohort_day, count() AS installs,
 countIf(onboard_day0) AS onboard_day0_users,
 countIf(day0_posts >= 1) AS posted_day0_users,
 countIf(day0_posts >= 2) AS posted_twice_day0_users,
 countIf(day0_posts >= 3) AS posted_three_day0_users,
 countIf(arrayExists(d -> dateDiff('day',cohort_day,d)=1, active_days)) AS returned_d1,
 countIf(arrayExists(d -> dateDiff('day',cohort_day,d)=3, active_days)) AS returned_d3,
 countIf(arrayExists(d -> dateDiff('day',cohort_day,d)=7, active_days)) AS returned_d7,
 countIf(arrayExists(d -> dateDiff('day',cohort_day,d) BETWEEN 1 AND 7, active_days)) AS returned_days1_7,
 countIf(arrayExists(d -> d>cohort_day, active_days)) AS returned_any_later,
 sum(day0_posts) AS posts_day0
FROM (
 SELECT *, arrayCount(d -> d=cohort_day,post_days) AS day0_posts, arrayExists(d -> d=cohort_day,onboarding_days) AS onboard_day0 FROM (
 SELECT person_id,
 toDate(toTimeZone(minIf(timestamp,event='Application Installed'),'Asia/Tokyo')) AS cohort_day,
 groupUniqArrayIf(toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Tokyo')),event='daily_active') AS active_days,
 groupArrayIf(toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Tokyo')),event='post_created') AS post_days,
 groupArrayIf(toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Tokyo')),event='onboarding_completed') AS onboarding_days
 FROM events WHERE {filters}
 AND timestamp>=toDateTime('2026-10-19 15:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp<toDateTime('2026-11-16 15:00:00','UTC')
 AND event IN ('Application Installed','daily_active','post_created','onboarding_completed')
 GROUP BY person_id HAVING countIf(event='Application Installed')>0
)
) GROUP BY cohort_day ORDER BY cohort_day LIMIT 40
queries.firstDayDepth:
SELECT if(day0_posts=0,'0',if(day0_posts=1,'1',if(day0_posts=2,'2','3+'))) AS day0_post_group,
count() AS users, countIf(onboard_day0) AS onboard_users,
countIf(arrayExists(d -> dateDiff('day',cohort_day,d)=1,active_days)) AS returned_d1,
countIf(arrayExists(d -> dateDiff('day',cohort_day,d) BETWEEN 1 AND 7,active_days)) AS returned_days1_7
FROM (
 SELECT *, arrayCount(d -> d=cohort_day,post_days) AS day0_posts, arrayExists(d -> d=cohort_day,onboarding_days) AS onboard_day0 FROM (
 SELECT person_id,
 toDate(toTimeZone(minIf(timestamp,event='Application Installed'),'Asia/Tokyo')) AS cohort_day,
 groupUniqArrayIf(toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Tokyo')),event='daily_active') AS active_days,
 groupArrayIf(toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Tokyo')),event='post_created') AS post_days,
 groupArrayIf(toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Tokyo')),event='onboarding_completed') AS onboarding_days
 FROM events WHERE {filters}
 AND timestamp>=toDateTime('2026-10-19 15:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp<toDateTime('2026-11-16 15:00:00','UTC')
 AND event IN ('Application Installed','daily_active','post_created','onboarding_completed')
 GROUP BY person_id HAVING countIf(event='Application Installed')>0
)
) WHERE cohort_day >= toDate('2026-11-03') AND cohort_day<=toDate('2026-11-09') GROUP BY day0_post_group ORDER BY day0_post_group LIMIT 10
queries.validFlows:
SELECT count() AS normal_post_flows, countIf(received>0) AS received_flows,
countIf(failed>0) AS had_failure_flows, countIf(received=0) AS not_received_flows,
countIf(viewed>0) AS viewed_flows,
quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS median_ms, quantile(0.9)(latency_ms) AS p90_ms,
quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM (SELECT person_id, properties.post_flow_id AS flow,
countIf(event='ai_replies_received') AS received, countIf(event='ai_replies_failed') AS failed,
countIf(event='ai_replies_viewed') AS viewed,
maxIf(toFloat(properties.duration_ms),event='ai_replies_received') AS latency_ms
FROM events WHERE {filters} AND timestamp >=toDateTime('2026-11-02 15:00:00','UTC')
AND timestamp <toDateTime('2026-11-16 15:00:00','UTC')
AND event IN ('post_created','ai_replies_received','ai_replies_failed','ai_replies_viewed')
AND properties.post_flow_id IS NOT NULL AND properties.post_flow_id!=''
GROUP BY person_id, flow HAVING countIf(event='post_created')>0)
